findings.finding: MDCX has an open, effective at-the-market Equity Distribution Agreement (12/29/2025, Yorkville Securities as agent, upsized to $50m on 2026-04-23). It sold 28.2m shares for $12.9m in H1 2026 and 2.8m more after quarter end. It carries going-concern language and paid Pfizer $12m upfront on 2026-09-02, so it can sell into any bounce on 2026-10-14.
findings.mechanism_in_window: ATM sales need no new filing and settle daily. The registration is effective and the issuer has drawn repeatedly. The 2026-09-14 8-K confirms Yorkville remains sales agent under the EDA after the SEPA was terminated, so supply can hit the 10-14 session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Through 2026 the ATM ran alongside a -81% 60-day path. The baseline's post-split sequence shows next-day closes of -9.8%, -22.2% and the -7.1% today, with no rebound session yet.
findings.why_not_priced: The price holds the split and the dilution done so far, not the sales still to come. If the market believed the ATM was idle (baby-shelf capacity exhausted or terminated), a fall on 0.87x volume would be expected to stabilise, as the under-2x base rate (+1.46%) suggests. Further sales would show as a fifth down session on rising volume with no news.
findings.independence: The 8-K of 2026-09-14 (Yorkville remains agent under the 12/29/2025 EDA): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1997296/000106299326004906/form8k.htm. Remaining usable capacity under the baby-shelf limit is NOT sourced, so the finding is sized small.
